name: Horizon Relay
description: Maintain spacecraft data relays from three rotating ground stations and hand off links at the horizon.
natural_language: Read the rotating 3D globe, aim a visible station at each requested spacecraft, keep each transfer moving, and hand off before a horizon loss.

metadata.notes: Original 3D relay contract grounded in ART-423. The browser shows an inspectable globe projection; server grading independently replays station positions, planet occlusion, aiming, transfer samples, and handoffs.
